audit.whatIsWrong: lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeGood string verbatim under an unrelated title. lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED: the body was the tradeBad string verbatim under an unrelated title. lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT: the cooldowns field carried no cooldown number.
audit.why: An earlier proposal targeted these same fields but its replacement text overshot the +/-10% length rule, so apply-proposals dropped the edit and the defect survived on disk.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the same meaning inside the length budget, grounded in real ability names and cooldowns from champ-data/_kits: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: E the contact, detonate, weave the passive auto, and keep Q visibly loaded — the chip is free and the root threat does the zoning.
edits.after: Lucent Singularity slows before it detonates — drop it at her feet first, then Light Binding into the slow, and the root actually lands.

edits.before: Q-poking on cooldown and facing the dive with an empty root slot — Lux without the binding banked is everyone's favorite snack.
edits.after: Final Spark trades even at equal HP, so the winner is whoever rooted first — with Light Binding down you lose that exchange.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Check it before every step-up. - W Prismatic Barrier is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Light Binding: 10s flat — everything she throws keys off that root, so minion-block it and her combo never starts. Check it before every step-up. - Prismatic Barrier is 12s and it is the lifeline; chip never gets it. - Final Spark is 60s: fights, not waves.

notes: QA re-scope: previous edits to dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns were rejected for length drift; re-proposed within budget. Cooldowns quoted are Riot per-rank values from the kit files; no spell-shield, cleanse or minion-block behaviour is asserted anywhere, since the kits do not state it.
